name: pickup_spawn_list_contains_pickup_id
description: Pickup::SpawnListContainsPickupId checks whether a sorted pickup spawn list contains the candidate spawn pickup id.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Pickup spawn-list source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41e900 validates fastcall ECX=candidate spawn, EDX=PickupSpawnList, reading list->head, comparing candidate pickupId against each entry pickupId, returning 1 on match, returning 0 on empty list, early returning 0 when candidate id is less than the current sorted entry id, and returning 0 after exhausting the list.
The native pickup leaf helper smoke verifies sorted-list hit, empty-list miss, before-head early miss, middle-gap miss, and after-tail miss.
